entities.name: Áurea of San Millán
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Aurea or Oria (1043–1070), was a Spanish anchorite saint attached to the Monastery of San Millán de la Cogolla, in the Spanish Province of La Rioja (Europe). She is commemorated on 11 March.
